name: texobj
title: texobj (Brian Paul; Mesa tests)
_version: mesa-demos 8.0.1 (2010-07-13), the first release of the demos as their own repository: GL 1.x and GLUT only, before the GLEW and later glad loaders and PNG textures arrived.
_doc: Two texture objects bound in turn onto two spinning quads -- glGenTextures, glBindTexture, glTexImage2D with NEAREST and LINEAR filters, glIsTexture. Held to Mesa by tools/gate-mesa-demos.mjs.
